rules.rule: the DiffSinger renderer applies its own onset undershoot (~-30.5c median) at note starts; written onset dips below ~150c are partially redundant — large SOURCE undershoots still need explicit encoding but can be scaled by ~0.6-0.8
written PITD excursion survives the renderer at ~0.80 median ratio (rng/pitd_rng) — expect damping, encode ~1.2x the intended render depth
SOURCE excursions >=250c are consistently encoded by the human (10 of 13 events reach >=50% of source magnitude) — big real gestures belong in PITD, not native parameters

where SOURCE is flat (<60c, reliable), the tuner still writes 150-350c PITD on 10 of 14 events — expression is partly authored for musicality, not only traced; agent may add moderate motion on sustained notes when source is flat

vibrato is encoded almost exclusively as PITD oscillation (1 native-vibrato note in 393 vs dozens of 4-8Hz pitd-osc notes); render reproduces it at reduced depth — prefer PITD over native vibrato for source-matched vibrato
